# Thenith — Smart Digital Identity & Luxury NFC Cards
> Thenith is an advanced digital identity and networking platform providing luxury NFC smart business cards and comprehensive digital portfolio profiles for individuals and businesses.

## Overview
- Official Website: https://thenith.com
- Domain: https://thenith.com
- Primary Language: Arabic (ar) with full English (en) support
- Headquarters & Service: Middle East & Global
- Contact: info@thenith.com

## Core Products & Capabilities
1. Luxury Smart NFC Cards: Physical premium smart cards (matte, metallic, custom-printed) integrated with contactless NFC chips and dynamic QR codes for instant contact sharing on iOS and Android without requiring any app.
2. Digital Identity Profiles: Hosted, responsive public profile pages (`/p/{username}`) showcasing verified contact details, professional titles, biographies, portfolios, booking calendars, and social links.
3. Subscription Plans: Free, Basic, and Pro tiers offering dynamic QR management, advanced analytics, custom links, and white-label branding.
4. Business & Personal Solutions: Tailored digital solutions for graphic designers, software engineers, creatives, executives, agencies, and enterprises.

## Public Indexable URL Structure
- Landing Page: https://thenith.com/
- Smart Cards & Store: https://thenith.com/products
- Pricing & Subscription Plans: https://thenith.com/pricing
- Suggest Features: https://thenith.com/suggest
- Public Profiles: https://thenith.com/p/{username}

## Technical Architecture
- Frontend: React + Vite Single Page Application
- Canonical URL enforcement: `https://thenith.com`
- Structured Data: Schema.org `ProfilePage`, `Person`, `Organization`, `Product`, `WebSite` JSON-LD
- Sitemap: https://thenith.com/sitemap.xml
